input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Our only exit is 90 days' notice and, if we exercise it, Section 4.2(a) imposes a Termination Payment, so we have no penalty-free convenience right; meanwhile HDI may walk away mid-term on the same notice, which the fallback permits only at the end of a term. We added a 30-day Company convenience right with a pro-rata refund and limited HDI to end-of-term non-renewal; the quantum of the Termination Payment is redlined under LD.

input.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews for successive one-year terms with a 90-day non-renewal window, which exceeds our fallback of no more than 60 days; there is also no renewal reminder. We shortened the window to 30 days and kept the 12-month renewal term; no price-uplift cap is needed as fees are a percentage of Net Sales.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: New York law is our preferred governing law and there is no arbitration provision or foreign venue. The clause is silent on forum; we would add exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, but that is a drafting point rather than a deviation.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 contains no prohibition on assignment and expressly runs to successors and assigns, so we retain freedom to assign to an affiliate or an M&A successor, and there is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right against us. This meets the fallback (mutual assignability to successors); we would prefer a consent requirement on HDI's assignments, particularly to a competitor, but the clause as drafted works in our favour and we are not redlining it.

input.quote: Except as provided herein, no licenses of the Company's Marks are granted or implied under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Nothing in the Agreement allocates ownership of the Site, work product or the customer, user and order data collected through it; we only have editorial control (5.2) and a reservation on our Marks (6.1). With HDI building and hosting everything on its own servers at its own cost, that silence leaves our deliverable and our data unprotected, so we inserted a Company ownership and Company Data clause with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and granting us a perpetual licence to embedded HDI materials.

input.quote: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
input.rationale: The grant of access to HDI's system, software and administration tools runs to the Company alone, with no mention of affiliates or contractors acting for us and no path to add them, and no protection against HDI suspending or revoking access at will. We added affiliates and contractors, limited revocation to termination or our uncured material breach, and made the rights transferable to a successor.

input.quote: 3.4 HDI's General Manager (as hereinafter defined), may upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect the records of the Company's General Manager reasonably related to the calculation of such payments during the Company's normal business hours.
input.rationale: The inspection right has acceptable notice (30 days), business-hours limitation, a narrow record scope and HDI bearing the cost, but no frequency cap at all, so HDI could inspect repeatedly. We inserted a once-per-12-month limit as a single-line edit; the absence of an independent-auditor requirement is a residual point we can live with.

input.quote: the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two
input.rationale: Section 4.2 makes us pay a liquidated amount equal to half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000 — a multiple of the 30% revenue-share fees we actually pay, and payable only by us (HDI owes nothing if the formula is negative). That fails the fallback cap of three months' fees, so we capped the Termination Payment at three months' payments under Section 3.1 as the sole liquidated amount.

input.quote: (a) Each Party represents and warrants to the other Party that (1) it is a corporation organized, validly existing and in goodstanding under the laws of the state of its incorporation;
input.rationale: Section 9 contains only corporate-authority representations — there is no warranty that the Site will be built or operated in a workmanlike manner, no conformance warranty and no remedy, which falls below even the 30/90-day fallback. We inserted a workmanlike-performance warranty, a 90-day conformance warranty against the specifications we approve, compliance with law and no malicious code, with repair/replace/refund at HDI's option.

input.quote: 10. General Provisions.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, although HDI hosts our Site and processes our customers' order and user data. We inserted a short insurance paragraph in the general provisions with our standard CGL, E&O and cyber limits plus certificates on request; severity is low and the limits are negotiable down to the E&O/cyber fallback.

input.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: Fees are purely a revenue share on actual Net Sales, with no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume restriction on us (the $11,000 monthly threshold operates in our favour as an exemption). The termination payment is addressed under LD, not as a minimum commitment.

input.quote: 4. Term; Termination; Termination Payment.
input.rationale: Section 4 and the survival clause say nothing about exit: no transition assistance, no return or export of our Content and customer/order data held on HDI's servers, and no deletion obligation. We inserted a transition-assistance and data-return paragraph (six months' assistance at HDI's rates, export within 30 days in machine-readable format, then certified deletion).

content.text:
All 17 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Critical gaps (inserted clauses):**
- **LOL-CAP** – no liability provision at all; added a mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M) with uncapped carve-outs.
- **INDEMN** – no indemnity anywhere; added HDI indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct.
- **IP** – no ownership allocation for the Site, work product or customer/user data; added Company ownership plus HDI licence-back.

**High/medium deviations (edited in place):**
- **LD** – Termination Payment (half of trailing Net Sales over $800k) capped at 3 months' fees.
- **T4C** – added 30-day Company convenience right with refund; limited HDI to end-of-term non-renewal.
- **RENEWAL** – 90-day non-renewal window shortened to 30 days.
- **NONCOMPETE** – Section 6.1 restriction narrowed to Deerskin Products, 12 months, with development/M&A carve-outs.
- **LICENSE** – access rights extended to affiliates/contractors, made non-revocable at will and transferable.
- **WARRANTY** – added workmanlike/90-day conformance warranty with remedy.
- **AUDIT** – inspection right limited to once per 12 months.
- **INSURANCE**, **TRANSITION** – short standard paragraphs inserted (data return/deletion is the more important of the two given HDI holds our customer data).

**Acceptable as drafted:** EXCLUSIVITY (defined channel, one-year term, delivery-failure exit), MFN (runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT (none), GOVLAW (New York, no arbitration), ASSIGN (successors permitted, no change-of-control trigger), MINCOMMIT (pure revenue share).
